text:
Predicates:
GainedKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x becomes smarter.
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Author(y, z) ::: y is authored by z.
Premises:
Reads(harry, walden) ∧ Book(walden) ∧ Author(walden, henryThoreau) ::: Harry read the book 'Walden' by Henry Thoreau.
When a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge ::: Reading a book causes the person to gain knowledge.
If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter ::: Gaining knowledge implies becoming smarter.
Conclusion:
GainedKnowledge(harry) → Smarter(harry) ::: If Harry gained knowledge, then Harry is smarter.
